annotations.title: 株式会社インテルゲート｜intelgate,Inc.

content.text:
**“IntelGate” can refer to a few different things, depending on context:**

1. **A U.S. political/intelligence controversy** — often styled **“Intelgate”** — involving allegations that U.S. Central Command intelligence reports about ISIS/ISIL and the wars in Syria and Iraq were manipulated or politicized, beginning around 2015. ([military-history.fandom.com](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Intelgate?utm_source=openai))

2. **A Japanese company, 株式会社インテルゲート / intelgate, Inc.** — an internet/business consulting and web services company based in Tokyo. Its name combines “intel” from an Italian-derived word for internet and “gate,” meaning an entry point. ([intelgate.co.jp](https://intelgate.co.jp/?utm_source=openai))

3. **A software/digital solutions company called INTELGATE** — listed on LinkedIn as a small software development company based in Gazimağusa, Northern Cyprus, founded in 2017. ([cy.linkedin.com](https://cy.linkedin.com/company/intelgate?utm_source=openai))

If you saw “IntelGate” in a news article, it most likely means the **political/intelligence scandal**; if you saw it on a product/company site, it may refer to one of the companies.
